fields.name: PgShardConnectionOptions
fields.contract: PgShardConnectionOptions accepts its provider-specific shard-set configurations in PgShardSets and exposes that configured collection through IShardSetsConfigurationOptions.ShardSetsConfigInternal as IShardSetConnectionsConfiguration[]; the shared view is the configured array itself, not a separately constructed collection, so element order and each entry's shard-set identity, default shard identifier, shard collection, and read/write configuration views are preserved.
